caption: The drawing features a highly detailed chair colored in shades of deep red and black, with a carved wooden frame that includes ornate floral designs at the top of the backrest and on the seat apron. The cushioned seat and backrest are depicted in black, with realistic shading that suggests a velvety texture. The chair has four curved legs, also adorned with carved details. To the right of the chair, there are three smaller pencil sketches: an arched floral carving matching the top detail of the chair, a simple triangular motif, and an outline of a chair leg with a small floral embellishment. The drawing is rendered on a light beige background, with the colored portion focusing on the chair’s main structure while the sketches provide design details.
title: Balter Chair
